hermes.snapshot_reason: Archive baseline containing the documented PluginContext.subagent_lifecycle API, native Runs control plane, Gateway attachment/session/input-response contracts, Dashboard model/custom-endpoint/session/config surfaces, delegation/review routing, approvals, Skills, Plugins and MCP surfaces required by Worker Studio 3.0. Final Product seal additionally requires the route-scoped exclusive Dashboard shell contract tracked below; this pin intentionally remains non-sealable until an official Hermes revision contains that contract.

dashboard_route_scoped_exclusive_shell.semantics: A dashboard plugin overriding a route can officially suppress the built-in Hermes shell only while that route is active; native shell/navigation automatically returns on native routes.
